title: Longest palindromic substring

problem.name: Longest palindromic substring
problem.statement_latex: Given $S\in\Sigma^n$, find a longest interval $[i,j]$ satisfying $S[i+t]=S[j-t]$ for every admissible $t$. Complexity counts character queries and random-access time.
problem.statement_text: Given $S\in\Sigma^n$, find a longest interval $[i,j]$ satisfying $S[i+t]=S[j-t]$ for every admissible $t$. Complexity counts character queries and random-access time.
